the general conditions for identifiability of finite mixtures are sufficient for the models considered in this paper.

The main takeaway from our work is that

, under the assumption of independent and identically distributed observations, the general conditions are sufficient for identifiability of finite mixtures with varying and fixed parameters, and that the conditions are easy to check for a large class of models.
the identifiability conditions are not only of theoretical importance but can also be used to guide the choice of a model in practice.

the identifiability conditions for finite mixtures of logit models are more general than those previously known and the results have important practical implications for the interpretation of parameters in finite mixture models with varying and fixed covariates.
